about: Traced by tools/trace_pdf.py from the MFA visitor map PDF. Coordinates are PDF points (x right, y down) of each floor's own drawing; `transform` [scale, dx, dy] lines the floor up with Level 2. Room kinds: gallery (numbered), space (named: courtyards, cafés, shops, auditoriums), corridor. `closed` areas are grey on the PDF (not open to visitors). `amenities` come from the map icons.
